tip.title: Use tonight's Russian block for ship-day phrases
tip.body: Spend part of the two-hour Russian session on lines you may need on board or in port, like where is the elevator, how much does this cost, and I need help. Say each one out loud a few times so the words are ready when the room is noisy.

surprise.title: Sound barrier day: Yeager, then Baumgartner
surprise.body: On this date in 1947, Chuck Yeager hit Mach 1.05 in the Bell X-1 and became the first pilot confirmed to break the sound barrier in level flight. Sixty-five years later to the day, on October 14, 2012, Felix Baumgartner jumped from about 39 kilometers up over New Mexico and became the first person to break the sound barrier in freefall, about Mach 1.25. Two sky firsts, same calendar square.
